lessonTitle: Equations on a Number Line PLC Activity

stageA.sourceSpecificSummary: IM2021 Grade2 Unit4 Lesson8 Equations on a Number Line PLC Activity. Warm-up CHORAL COUNT backward by10, in three distinct runs: from99 down to49 (99,89,79,69,59,49), from98 to48 (98,88,78,68,58,48), and from95 to45 (95,85,75,65,55,45). Ones digit stays the SAME while tens digit decreases one per step. Original Activity1 REPRESENT four equations on actual equally spaced paper number lines:15+7=22 (15→22 right7),18−6=12 (18→12 left6),46+7=53 (46→53 right7),33−9=24 (33→24 left9). The printed source first two lines are0..40 by5, third0..60 by5, fourth0..40 by5; a five-labelled interval does not mean each movement is five units. Students draw arrow with correct START/END and direction, then discuss MLR8 with partner. Original Activity2 WRITE an equation from FOUR genuine diagrams:3→15 means3+12=15;15→12 means15−3=12;15→3 means15−12=3;12→15 means12+3=15. Compare which diagrams are similar and why, using ORIGINAL figures. Teacher checks physical arrow drawing, original images and peer discussion, not just computed answers. Restricted publisher Cool-down not reproduced.
